notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Elite Arcanist.
Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Elite Arcanist's ability by paying {1} and tapping it, casting a copy of Songs of the Damned without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Songs of the Damned, adding at least {2}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Elite Arcanist.
Repeat.
If you have three or more creature cards in your graveyard, this combo nets infinite mana.
